clue.text: Carried nothing to a Pacific island

parts.note: carried means borne, the past participle of bear
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone ferried nothing out to a remote island in the Pacific.
explanation.walkthrough: Borneo is strictly in the Malay Archipelago, between the Pacific and Indian Oceans, but the setter allows it as a Pacific island.
explanation.definitionFit: Borneo is a large island in South-East Asia, on the western edge of the Pacific region.

clue.text: Jack to get under way as mentioned and let himself down the rock-face

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and AB (able seaman) is the usual crossword sailor

indicators.note: as mentioned means as spoken, so the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: a ship that gets under way is said to sail

explanation.surface: A sailor sets off, then lowers himself down a cliff on a rope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to ... let' is the infinitive, so 'let himself down' stands for the base verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To abseil is to descend a cliff face by sliding down a rope.

clue.text: Sheer pleasure having a drink with the game

parts.note: beer is a drink
with means and
skittles is a pub game like ninepins

explanation.surface: Pure enjoyment: a pint while playing a pub game.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'all beer and skittles' means nothing but fun and enjoyment.

clue.text: Plan for one who doesn't know which way to turn

definitions.text: Plan for one who doesn't know which way to turn

parts.words: Plan for one who doesn't know which way to turn
parts.note: a person at a loss, not knowing which way to turn, read literally as a lost traveller needing directions on paper

explanation.definitionFit: A road map is a chart of routes, and figuratively a plan for achieving something.

clue.text: Timely thief, so it is said

definitions.text: Timely thief, so it is said

parts.words: Timely thief, so it is said
parts.note: refers to the proverb that delay of this kind is the thief of time

explanation.definitionFit: The saying goes that putting things off steals time, so this habit of delay is the proverbial thief of time.

clue.text: Cat looked, having keen sight

parts.note: the lynx is a wild cat
eyed means looked at

explanation.definitionFit: The lynx was proverbial for sharp vision, so the compound describes someone very observant.

clue.text: Indicate hours spent in the intervening period

parts.note: to indicate is to mean or signify
hours that are spent amount to time

explanation.surface: Show how many hours passed during the gap.
explanation.definitionFit: The meantime is the interval between two events.

clue.text: A Mexican overhead?

parts.note: read as a thing from Mexico worn over the head rather than a Mexican person above

explanation.definitionFit: The sombrero is the wide-brimmed hat traditionally worn in Mexico.

clue.text: Came to a similar conclusion, we hear

definitions.text: Came to a similar conclusion, we hear

parts.words: Came to a similar conclusion, we hear
parts.note: lines of verse that end with the same sound, as the ear detects, rather than people agreeing

explanation.definitionFit: Lines that rhymed ended with matching sounds, a similar conclusion to the ear.

clue.text: Past a green light

parts.note: a green light is the signal to go

explanation.surface: Driving past a traffic light showing green.
explanation.definitionFit: Ago means in the past, as in 'years ago'.

clue.text: Charmed beloved

definitions.meaning: charmed means won the affection of
beloved here means made dear, held in affection

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who charmed others won their affection, and one so loved has been made dear to them.

clue.text: Persuading second mate to leave whilst steering a boat

indicators.note: to leave means a letter departs from the word for persuading

parts.note: persuading gently is coaxing

indicators.note: second picks the second letter of the word mate

explanation.surface: Talking a crewmate into quitting while at the helm of a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second mate' looks like a ship's officer, but it is the second letter of 'mate', A.
explanation.definitionFit: A cox steers a rowing boat, so coxing is the act of steering one.

clue.text: Match overstatement?

parts.note: read as an exaggeration about a game, but meaning a cricket statement of overs, runs and wickets in a match

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a bowler delivers 'overs' of six balls; the bowling analysis is the statement of overs, maidens, runs and wickets.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowling analysis records a cricket bowler's figures across a match.

clue.text: Beware, internal strife

indicators.note: internal means the letters sit inside the word Beware

explanation.surface: A warning to watch out for conflict at home.
explanation.definitionFit: War is armed conflict, strife on a large scale.

clue.text: Broadcast serials that are stuffy

indicators.note: broadcast suggests scattering, so the letters of serials are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Radio or TV series that are dull and old-fashioned.
explanation.definitionFit: A stuffy room lacks fresh air.

clue.text: Colourfully in debt

definitions.meaning: a phrase that names a colour

explanation.definitionFit: Overdrawn accounts were once shown in red ink, so being in debt is described with a colour.

clue.text: One said in France to have been included by the girl with clarity

indicators.note: included by means the other letters go inside the girl's name

parts.note: Lucy is a girl's name
one is the Roman numeral I
dit is French for said

explanation.surface: A remark in French, taken in by a young woman, makes things clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucidity is clearness of thought or expression.

clue.text: Provided ornamentation placed at intervals

explanation.definitionFit: A studded belt is decorated with metal knobs, and things studded about are dotted here and there.

clue.text: The point on which one is punctual

definitions.text: The point on which one is punctual

parts.words: The point on which one is punctual
parts.note: refers to the idiom of arriving exactly on time, on a small mark

explanation.definitionFit: A dot is a small point, and someone exactly on time is 'on the' one.

clue.text: Sergeant-major and I had the information, a very small amount

parts.note: I had contracts to I'd
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: An army sergeant-major and I knew only a tiny bit.
explanation.definitionFit: A smidgen is a tiny quantity, a little bit.

clue.text: Words of encouragement parliamentarian has for a Scottish pastor

parts.note: 'stick it!' urges someone to keep going
a government minister sits in parliament

explanation.surface: A politician offers some cheering words to a Scottish clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: A stickit minister is Scots for a trained preacher who never got a parish.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland the term names a licensed preacher who never obtained a church of their own.

clue.text: Blunder with students rising

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word for students is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: pupils are students

explanation.surface: A mistake as the students get to their feet.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip-up is a careless mistake.

clue.text: They go out during play

parts.note: read as people leaving a game, but it is the Latin stage direction for several actors leaving

explanation.definitionFit: In a script the Latin stage direction meaning 'they leave' tells several actors to exit.

clue.text: Prepare again rush item

parts.note: a rush is a reed, a waterside plant
it can stand for an item or thing

explanation.surface: Get an urgent piece ready once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To re-edit is to revise text for publication a second time.

clue.text: The last part in the act was fully described

indicators.note: in means the end piece goes inside the word for act

parts.note: a deed is an act
the tail is the last part of something

explanation.surface: The final scene of the play was described thoroughly.
explanation.definitionFit: To detail something is to set it out item by item.

clue.text: Fuel record

definitions.meaning: a length of wood for the fire

explanation.definitionFit: Firewood is burnt as fuel, and a ship's journal is a written record.

clue.text: Quality of character of eg iron, say

indicators.note: say means the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: iron is an example of a metal

explanation.surface: Strength of personality, as tough as iron.
explanation.definitionFit: Mettle is courage and spirit, strength of character.

clue.text: Articulate lot queen removed

indicators.note: removed suggests moved away from their places, so the letters of lot queen are rearranged

explanation.surface: A good speaker sees a whole group of queens deposed.
explanation.definitionFit: Eloquent means fluent and expressive in speech.
